description: This file defines configuration settings for a Sachs engine within a firmware project. It includes specifications for engine parameters such as displacement, cylinders, trigger configuration, ADC channels, fuel injection, and other engine-specific settings. The function setSachs initializes these parameters.

methods.name: void setSachs(DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SIGNATURE)
methods.description: Initializes engine configuration parameters specific to Sachs engine type, including engine specs, trigger settings, ADC channels, fuel and timing curves, and sensor configurations.
